title: Cheezechoice
description: A food delivery service website designed to make local ordering feel fast and friendly.
imageCaption: A warm, clear interface keeps the menu and ordering flow easy to scan.
body: Cheezechoice is a food delivery service website built around quick discovery and a simple path to checkout.
I focused on a responsive layout, clear food categories, and lightweight interactions that help local customers order without friction.

title: Code 365
description: A placement journey platform that helps students prepare, learn, and stay on track.
imageCaption: Progress-oriented screens turn a long placement journey into clear next steps.
body: Code 365 gives students one place to navigate their placement journey, from preparation through progress tracking.
The product combines an approachable student experience with analytics and a dependable Vercel deployment workflow.

title: Chatura Solutions
description: An online learning platform with courses, quizzes, and progress tracking.
imageCaption: Course content is organized into a focused, welcoming learning space.
body: Chatura Solutions needed a learning platform that made courses, quizzes, and progress easy to manage.
I shaped the site around clear course discovery and a practical content-management workflow for the team behind it.

title: NRIT Upskills
description: A training platform for NRIT Upskills Software Solutions with payments and course delivery.
imageCaption: A structured course catalog gives learners an inviting place to begin.
body: NRIT Upskills is an online learning experience built for course delivery, secure payments, and clear learner progress.
The implementation connects the editorial flexibility of WordPress with LMS and Stripe workflows.

title: Upper Room Church Website
description: An online presence for a church with event management and community engagement features.
imageCaption: The visual language makes room for community stories, events, and welcome.
body: The Upper Room Church website gives the community a clear home for events, updates, and connection.
I prioritized a welcoming content structure, searchable pages, and analytics foundations that the team can manage confidently.

title: Smart Mart
description: An ecommerce platform for a local retail business with payments and analytics.
imageCaption: A focused storefront helps customers move from product discovery to purchase.
body: Smart Mart is an ecommerce platform built for a local retail business that needed a dependable online storefront.
The project brings together a clear catalog, payment gateway integration, search visibility, and analytics.

title: Drona LMS
description: An online learning management system developed for Code 365.
imageCaption: A practical dashboard keeps learning progress visible at a glance.
body: Drona LMS is a learning management system for Code 365, designed to make digital course delivery easier to operate.
The build focuses on a durable application foundation, payment-ready flows, and useful progress signals for learners and administrators.
